title: timelesz’s ‘Kienai Hanabi’ Scores No. 1 as Five ‘Chiikawa’ Film Tracks Chart on Japan Hot 100
summary: ILLIT's "I Got Your Back (feat. JISOO, MOMOKA of HANA)" debuts at No. 2.
contentText:
timelesz’s “Kienai Hanabi” hits No. 1 on the Billboard Japan Hot 100, on the chart released Aug. 5.

The title track of the second single released under the group’s new lineup serves as the theme song to Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to , in which member Shori Sato makes his animated feature film lead debut. It sold 424,416 copies in its first week to rule sales, while coming in at No. 3 for downloads and No. 15 for radio airplay. Under the timelesz name, the group’s previous peak on the overall chart was No. 2 with “Steal The Show,” making “Kienai Hanabi” the group’s first No. 1. 

ILLIT’s “I Got Your Back (feat. JISOO, MOMOKA of HANA)” debuts at No. 2. The title track of the group’s second Japanese single features HANA members JISOO and MOMOKA, who also contributed lyrics. Following a digital pre-release on July 26, the CD dropped July 29, moving 85,475 copies to hit No. 5 for sales, while also placing No. 3 for radio and No. 15 for video views. 

ATEEZ’s “BAD,” the group’s fifth Japanese single, jumps 64-3 with 259,030 copies to come in at No. 2 for sales and No. 22 for streaming.

Mrs. GREEN APPLE’s “Brand New” slips 2-4, but dominates streaming (7,510,396 weekly streams) for the second consecutive week while also topping radio. FRUITS ZIPPER member Yui Sakurai’s solo major-label debut single “Natsu Izon” debuts at No. 5 with 96,545 copies, followed by OCTPATH’s 10th single “Natsumeki” at No. 6 with 90,719 copies. CLASS SEVEN’s “I Know Hero” bows at No. 7 with No. 2 on radio and No. 6 on sales.

At No. 8 is M!LK’s “Sukisugite Metsu!” charting for its 40th week, posting No. 2 on streaming, video, and karaoke. King Gnu’s “GO GHOST” — the opener to the TV anime THE GHOST IN THE SHELL — lands at No. 9 with 13,349 downloads (No. 2).

Nineteen tracks debut this week. BE:FIRST’s “BRUCE WAYNE feat. Flo Milli, ATL Jacob,” released digitally on July 31, tops downloads and enters at No. 18. Gen Hoshino’s “Suki,” the theme song to the TBS drama Kimi no Suki wa Muteki , enters at No. 19 with No. 4 on downloads. ONE OR EIGHT’s “YANKEE SQUAT” arrives at No. 37 with No. 4 on radio, and Rikondensetsu’s “Daikuko,” the theme song to the TV Asahi drama Daikuko: GATE24 , enters at No. 46 with No. 6 on radio.

Five tracks tied to Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island , released in theaters July 24, also chart this week. “Shima no Uta (Siren ver.)” enters at No. 50, “Tsukue Sasuru” at No. 54, opening theme “Kutsuzure” at No. 68, and two versions of “Usagi Rap” at No. 75 and No. 86 — collectively sweeping the downloads list from No. 6 through No. 9.

The Billboard Japan Hot 100 combines physical and digital sales, audio streams, radio airplay, video views and karaoke data.
